# Skribly Newsletter

> A free weekly newsletter with AI news worth reading and what is new in Skribly. Every item has its source; no ads.

A short e-mail every week: what happened in AI that is worth your time, and what is new in Skribly.

## Pages

- [Issues](https://newsletter.skribly.pl/issues/): Every issue of Skribly Newsletter, newest first: AI news with a source under every item. Polish: https://newsletter.skribly.pl/pl/wydania/
- [About the newsletter](https://newsletter.skribly.pl/about/): Who writes Skribly Newsletter, how often it comes, how an issue is made and what it never does. Polish: https://newsletter.skribly.pl/pl/o-newsletterze/
- [Privacy](https://newsletter.skribly.pl/privacy/): What Skribly Newsletter stores about a subscriber, why, for how long, and how to have it removed. Polish: https://newsletter.skribly.pl/pl/prywatnosc/
- [RSS feed](https://newsletter.skribly.pl/rss.xml): RSS 2.0, every issue in full. Polish: https://newsletter.skribly.pl/pl/rss.xml

## Issues

- [Issue 8: AI agents check Signal's code with proofs, and new models](https://newsletter.skribly.pl/issues/0008-agents-verify-signal/): Google DeepMind used AI agents to prove security properties of the code behind Signal. Also: Claude Fable 5.2, Gemini 4 Carbon for everyone, open weights from Mistral and a coding agent from DeepSeek. Polish: https://newsletter.skribly.pl/pl/wydania/0008-agents-verify-signal/
- [Issue 7: AI checks planning applications, and Kimi K3.1 Pro weights](https://newsletter.skribly.pl/issues/0007-ai-planning-applications/): Google DeepMind and the UK government cut the time planning officers spend on routine applications by up to 58%. Also: Kimi K3.1 Pro weights, OpenAI models for biology and security, and a GitHub Actions change. Polish: https://newsletter.skribly.pl/pl/wydania/0007-ai-planning-applications/
- [Issue 6: Claude in drug labs, GPT-6.1 Terra and Genie 4](https://newsletter.skribly.pl/issues/0006-claude-drug-development/): Anthropic shared early results from drug developers who used Claude to design and check drug candidates. Also: GPT-6.1 Terra, Kimi K3.1 Pro, Genie 4 and agent workflows in GitHub Actions. Polish: https://newsletter.skribly.pl/pl/wydania/0006-claude-drug-development/
- [Issue 5: Claude Duet works on its own, and asks before it acts](https://newsletter.skribly.pl/issues/0005-claude-duet-agent/): Anthropic previewed Claude Duet, an agent app that keeps working while you are away. Also: a package firewall for coding agents on GitHub, new DeepSeek weights, Voxtral 3 with Polish, continuous scans in Claude Security and a map of the world's forests. Polish: https://newsletter.skribly.pl/pl/wydania/0005-claude-duet-agent/
- [Issue 4: Gemini 4 Argon arrives, and Meta opens the weights of Muse Spark](https://newsletter.skribly.pl/issues/0004-gemini-4-argon/): Google released Gemini 4 Argon to developers and the Gemini app. Also: open weights from Meta and Mistral, Anthropic's defences against distillation, outside evaluators inside Anthropic and Claude Code Review for teams. Polish: https://newsletter.skribly.pl/pl/wydania/0004-gemini-4-argon/
- [Issue 3: Claude Haiku 5.5, and free AI scans for open source](https://newsletter.skribly.pl/issues/0003-haiku-and-oss-scanner/): Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5, a small model built to work as a subagent. Also: AI security scans for open-source projects, Copilot sandboxes, stacked pull requests, a full ultraviolet map of the sky and an EU initiative for a .IA domain. Polish: https://newsletter.skribly.pl/pl/wydania/0003-haiku-and-oss-scanner/
- [Issue 2: Gemini 4 Argon goes to cyber defenders first, and new models](https://newsletter.skribly.pl/issues/0002-argon-for-defenders/): Google introduced Gemini 4 Argon and gave it first to a group of cyber defenders. Also: Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol, Copilot that uses desktop apps, open agent models from H Company and an EU consultation on copyright and AI. Polish: https://newsletter.skribly.pl/pl/wydania/0002-argon-for-defenders/
- [Issue 1: Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 on the same day](https://newsletter.skribly.pl/issues/0001-opus-and-gpt-6/): Anthropic released Claude Opus 5.5 on the day OpenAI added GPT-6 Sol and Luna to its API. Also: Grok 4.7, an enzyme system found by Claude agents, a leaders' call for control of frontier AI and agents in Dev Containers. Polish: https://newsletter.skribly.pl/pl/wydania/0001-opus-and-gpt-6/

## Optional

- [Licences](https://newsletter.skribly.pl/licenses/): The open source software and fonts that this site ships, each with its licence and its licence text.
